question: In 2025, did you have any of these adjustments to income: educator expenses; business expenses of a reservist, performing artist or fee-basis government official; a health savings account deduction; moving expenses for the Armed Forces; the deductible part of self-employment tax; a self-employed SEP, SIMPLE or qualified plan deduction; self-employed health insurance; a penalty on early withdrawal of savings; alimony you paid; an IRA deduction; an Archer MSA deduction; or any other adjustment listed on Schedule 1 lines 24a through 24z (do not count student loan interest)?
